name: io.github.jmrplens/gitlab-mcp-server
title: GitLab MCP Server
description: Go MCP server for GitLab: 2 dynamic tools reach ~879 actions on Free/CE, up to ~1106 on Ultimate.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_URL
environmentVariables.description: GitLab instance URL (default: https://gitlab.com; set for self-managed instances)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GitLab Personal Access Token (glpat-...)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_MCP_SKIP_TLS_VERIFY
environmentVariables.description: Skip TLS certificate verification for self-signed certs (default: false)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_MCP_TOOL_SURFACE
environmentVariables.description: Tool catalog selector: dynamic, meta, or individual (default: dynamic)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_MCP_TIER
environmentVariables.description: GitLab tier: free/ce, premium or ultimate, used as given. When unset, detected from the instance license, then from the plans of the namespaces the token administers, then, on GitLab.com, from the top-level groups the token is a member of, falling back to free. Gates Premium and Ultimate actions; GitLab.com Ultimate also serves the Orbit Knowledge Graph tools

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Read-only mode: removes every mutating action from the served surface; reads keep working (default: false)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_MCP_SAFE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Safe mode: a mutating action returns a preview card naming the action and echoing its arguments instead of running; reads keep working (default: false)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Logging verbosity (default: info)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Read-only mode: removes every mutating action from the served surface; reads keep working (default: false)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_MCP_SAFE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Safe mode: a mutating action returns a preview card naming the action and echoing its arguments instead of running; reads keep working (default: false)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_MCP_EMBEDDED_RESOURCES
environmentVariables.description: Append EmbeddedResource content blocks (clickable links to MCP resources) to get_* tool results (default: true)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_MCP_EXCLUDE_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names, group names or canonical action IDs to exclude, on every surface (e.g. gitlab_admin,gitlab_runner)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_MCP_IGNORE_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Skip the scope filter and the read_api narrowing and register all tools regardless of token permissions; a token carrying neither read_api nor api is still refused (default: false)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_MCP_UPLOAD_MAX_FILE_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Largest local file an upload or file-reading action accepts, in bytes or with a KB, MB or GB suffix (e.g. 2GB); at most 1 TB (default: 2147483648, 2 GB)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_MCP_ALLOWED_UPLOAD_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Extra OS path-list-separated directories an action may read a local file from; the working directory (unless it is the filesystem root or your home directory) and the OS temp directory are always allowed. Unused in HTTP mode, which refuses local paths

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_MCP_ALLOWED_DOWNLOAD_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Extra OS path-list-separated directories an action may write a downloaded file into; the working directory (unless it is the filesystem root or your home directory) and the OS temp directory are always allowed. Unused in HTTP mode, which refuses local paths

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_MCP_ALLOWED_IMPORT_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Extra OS path-list-separated directories a project or group import archive may be read from; the working directory (unless it is the filesystem root or your home directory) and the OS temp directory are always allowed. Unused in HTTP mode, which refuses local paths

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_MCP_RATE_LIMIT_RPS
environmentVariables.description: Rate limit per credential, in requests per second, on every call that reaches GitLab, with tools/list charged to a bucket of its own; 0, the default on stdio, disables it (default: 0)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_MCP_RATE_LIMIT_BURST
environmentVariables.description: Token-bucket burst size when GITLAB_MCP_RATE_LIMIT_RPS is greater than 0 (default: 40)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Logging verbosity (default: info)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_MCP_LANGUAGE
environmentVariables.description: Language of the elicitation questions, form field titles and progress messages a client shows the user: en or es (default: en). What the model reads stays English

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <token>. The endpoint runs in OAuth mode: a client that speaks the OAuth flow needs no header at all and discovers the authorization server from the 401 challenge. A GitLab personal access token also works here, sent as 'Bearer glpat-...', which keeps clients with no OAuth flow working. It travels per request and is never stored server-side.
